name: Amelia Edelweiss
original_name: アメリア・エーデルワイス
source:
The "Child of the Goddess" imprisoned in a mansion called "Strange House" in the quiet sea.

Quiet and withdrawn, but very clever. She has psychic powers.

She became a friend of Lily after a certain incident.

"I ... I want to be free."

[Translated from [url=https://mo-623-mo.amebaownd.com/posts/22701112]official website[/url]]
